channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Vasilije Micic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Vasilije Micic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ante Zizic on Vasilije Micic
item.description:
Ante Zizic on Vasilije Micic:

“Since the trade to Charlotte, he’s showing his true colors. He feels good and can show his true talent. I’m overjoyed for him because I expected him to play like this, only if he gets space. We saw him dominate in Europe, basketball is different there and now, when he plays on a wider court, I can his qualities, his vision of the field, his passes, his execution, are more pronounced. It’s certainly much easier for him there now”

Ante Zizic on Vasilije Micic, Mar 23, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Jaylin Williams on Vasilije Micic
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Jaylin Williams on Vasa Micic:

“From the first day we saw him play basketball right before Summer League, we knew that he was a game manager.”

Jaylin Williams on Vasilije Micic, Jan 23, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Vasilije Micic
item.description:
Sam Presti on Vasilije Micic:

“You don’t get to choose when things happen. In his case, he had a contract overseas. He had goals he wanted to achieve overseas. We had good communications. It just kind of lined up and made sense.”

Sam Presti on Vasilije Micic, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Jorge Garbajosa on Nikola Jokic, Vasilije Micic
item.description:
“Even though the team does not have big stars like [Nikola] Jokic, [Vasilije] Micic, [Nikola] Kalinic, and [Vladimir] Lucic, Serbia showed what team spirit means and how far the unity of all players around the same goal can take it. That's why I congratulate them on their great success.”

Jorge Garbajosa on Nikola Jokic, Vasilije Micic, Sep 9, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Svetislav Pesic on Vasilije Micic
item.description:
“As for [Vasilije] Micic, we had lengthy discussions, and he requested to skip this year. After a long season, dealing with injuries and signing with Oklahoma, he was unfortunate to sustain a shoulder injury during his stay there,and now he's in the process of recovery,”

Svetislav Pesic on Vasilije Micic, Jul 24, 2023. Source: BasketNews.
